tagline.en: InSpatio's world foundation model — a spatial-intelligence model that generates world frames and panoramas.
tagline.zh: InSpatio 的世界基础模型——一个生成世界帧与全景的空间智能模型。

en: InSpatio-WorldFM, from InSpatio, is a world foundation model focused on spatial intelligence. It generates video frames of a 3D world and can also produce panoramic views of the scene.

As a foundation-style world model, it treats frame generation and 3D spatial structure together, released as code and weights. It renders both a video stream and panorama artifacts from the same generation.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the WorldFM pipeline as a meta-demo task, producing the model's standard video and panorama output structure.
zh: InSpatio-WorldFM 由 InSpatio 开发,是一个聚焦空间智能的世界基础模型。它生成 3D 世界的视频帧,也能产出场景的全景视角。
作为基础模型式的世界模型,它把帧生成与 3D 空间结构统一处理,以代码加权重形式发布。它从同一次生成中同时渲染视频流与全景结果。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过 WorldFM pipeline 以 meta-demo 任务运行,产出该模型标准的视频与全景输出结构。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a world foundation model that generates both a video stream and panoramic views of a 3D scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个世界基础模型、同时生成 3D 场景的视频流与全景视角时,使用它。

notFor.en: It needs the WorldFM assets and a GPU to run, and is oriented toward world/panorama generation rather than plain text-to-video.
notFor.zh: 它需要 WorldFM 相关资源与 GPU 才能运行,面向世界/全景生成,而非普通的文生视频。

en: World foundation model for spatial intelligence
Generates world frames and panoramic views
Produces both video and panorama artifacts
zh: 面向空间智能的世界基础模型
生成世界帧与全景视角
